title: Settings
subtitle: App preferences, your security and your data.

general.label: General
general.intro: Your profile and how the app behaves.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.intro: What it sends to your phone.

security.label: Security
security.intro: Who can access your data, and how.

data.label: Data
data.intro: Back up, export or erase your data.

display.title: Display
display.description: Language, theme and simplified holdings are specific to this device; hiding amounts at startup applies everywhere.

language.title: Language
language.hint: Interface language. Date and amount formats follow it; your own data (labels, categories, notes) is not translated.

theme.title: Theme
theme.hint: “Auto” follows your system's light / dark setting.

privacyOnStart.label: Open with amounts hidden
privacyOnStart.hint: Privacy mode (the eye) is turned on every time the app opens, on all your devices. You can still show amounts afterwards.
privacyOnStart.enabled: The app will open with amounts hidden
privacyOnStart.disabled: Amounts will be shown when the app opens

simplifiedHoldings.label: Simplified holdings (brokerage accounts)
simplifiedHoldings.hint: Shows only the security (logo, name, ticker) and the number of shares: cost basis, prices, values, gains, dividends and weights are hidden.

backupCard.uneSauvegardeChiffreeEstFaite: An encrypted backup is made every 24 hours, then sent to the private GitHub repository if configured. The Action Center warns you if it hasn't run for 2 days.
backupCard.aucuneSauvegardeDepuisPlusDe: No backup for more than 2 days.
backupCard.aucuneSauvegardeTrouveeSurCe: No backup found on this server: automatic backups run in the
backupCard.laSauvegardeAEteCreee: The backup was created and sent to GitHub.

budgetPeriodCard.impossibleDeChangerLeMode: Unable to change the month split mode
budgetPeriodCard.chaqueSalaireRecuOuvreUn: Each salary received starts a new month: the salary of August 25 funds September, like the investments of the 29th. Transaction dates and balances do not change.

dangerZoneCard.supprimeTousLesComptesTransactions: Deletes all accounts, transactions and custom categories.
dangerZoneCard.cetteActionEstIrreversibleVous: This action is irreversible. You will lose ALL your data (accounts, transactions, categories).
dangerZoneCard.unInstantaneDeLaBase: A snapshot of the database is saved before erasing.

exportCard.telechargezVosDonneesPourLes: Download your data to use it elsewhere.

loginActivityCard.toutesLesSessionsOuvertesSeront: All open sessions will be closed, including this one: you will need to sign in again everywhere. Claude (MCP) tokens are not affected.
loginActivityCard.impossibleDeDeconnecterLesAppareils: Unable to sign out the devices
loginActivityCard.lesDernieresTentativesDeConnexion: The latest sign-in attempts, successful or not. A device you don't recognise: change your password and sign everything out.
loginActivityCard.impossibleDeChargerLHistorique: Unable to load the sign-in history.

mcpAccessCard.accesMcpCoupeTousLes: MCP access turned off: all tokens are refused
mcpAccessCard.donnezAClaudeCodeOu: Give Claude Code or Claude Desktop
mcpAccessCard.desactiveTousLesTokensSont: When off, all tokens are refused immediately (without deleting them).
mcpAccessCard.copiezLeMaintenantCeToken: Copy it now: this token will not be shown again.
mcpAccessCard.dansUnTerminalAjoutezNumera: In a terminal, add Numera to Claude Code:
mcpAccessCard.transmetLeTokenRedemarrezEnsuite: passes the token along). Then restart Claude Desktop.
mcpAccessCard.aucunTokenGenerezEnUn: No token: generate one to connect Claude.
mcpAccessCard.lesClientsQuiUtilisentCe: Clients using this token lose access immediately. This action is permanent.

notificationsTab.impossibleDeChargerLesReglages: Unable to load the notification settings.
notificationsTab.lesNouvellesAlertesDuCentre: New Action Center alerts (budget, subscription increase, account to check…) reach your phone, once each. Checked every hour.
notificationsTab.installezLAppNtfyAbonnez: Install the ntfy app, subscribe to a hard-to-guess topic, then enter it here. You can also use your own ntfy server.
notificationsTab.renseignezUnSujetPourEnvoyer: Enter a topic to send a test.
notificationsTab.creezUnBotAvecBotfather: Create a bot with @BotFather, send it a message, then enter its token and your chat id.
notificationsTab.renseignezLeJetonDuBot: Enter the bot token and chat id to send a test.
notificationsTab.leDimancheSoirDepensesEt: Sunday evening: the month's spending and income, pending actions, due dates for the next 7 days.
notificationsTab.remplaceLesMontantsParDans: Replaces amounts with ••• in messages (lock screen, watch…).
notificationsTab.rendLesNotificationsCliquablesVers: Makes notifications clickable to the right page.

passkeyCard.connectezVousAvecLaBiometrie: Sign in with your device's biometrics. The password remains usable. Register it from the address you actually use (the passkey is tied to the domain).
passkeyCard.passkeysNonPrisesEnCharge: Passkeys are not supported by this browser.

profileForm.deconnexionEnCoursSuiteAu: Signing out after the credentials change...
profileForm.tuEsSurLePoint: You are about to change your
profileForm.tuDevrasTeReconnecterAvec: . You will need to sign in again with your new credentials.
profileForm.saisisTonMotDePasse: Enter your current password to change your username
profileForm.leMotDePasseDoit: Password must be at least 8 characters
profileForm.auMoins8CaracteresTu: At least 8 characters. You will be signed out after the change.

totpCard.unCodeDeGoogleAuthenticator: A code from Google Authenticator (or equivalent) is requested after the password. Passkey sign-in is not affected: it is enough on its own.
totpCard.gardeLesEnLieuSur: Keep them somewhere safe: each one allows a sign-in without your phone, once. They will not be shown again.
totpCard.scanneCeQrCodeAvec: Scan this QR code with Google Authenticator, then enter the displayed code to confirm.
totpCard.ouSaisisCetteCleA: Or enter this key by hand:
totpCard.lesAnciensCodesDeSecours: The old backup codes will no longer work.
